english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a person with poor judgment or little intelligence.
For a naive or foolish person, this is the all-purpose colloquial choice.
Use this for an unintentionally ridiculous or foolish person rather than specifically a stage performer.
Use this for a person who behaves foolishly or acts silly, especially in casual speech.
